## In plain English

Two requests can look similar while requiring different model strengths. A
candidate profile attempts to say, for example, that one model is strong on
careful multi-step explanations while another is strong on short factual tasks.

## Evidence limits

The promoted profile fusion and higher-scoring diagnostics are development-only.
Some profile-construction artifacts are local or missing, and no hidden-test
claim follows.

## Linked studies

Raw labels, behavior topics, semantic profiles, and multiresolution profiles
provide distinct candidate-side comparisons.
